def main(input_grid):

    green_objects = detect_objects(grid=input_grid, colors=[Color.GREEN], monochromatic=True, connectivity=8)

    blit_sprite(output_grid, pattern, guide_x, guide_y, background=Color.BLACK)

    return output_grid

def generate_input():
    # Generate a grid of size between 6x6 and 10x10
    n, m = np.random.randint(6, 11), np.random.randint(6, 11)

    # Randomly place some objects of various colors

            blit_sprite(grid, sprite, x, y, background=Color.BLACK)

            continue  # If no space is found, skip

    green_sprite = random_sprite(n=3, m=3, color_palette=[Color.GREEN], density=0.5)

        blit_sprite(grid, green_sprite, x, y, background=Color.BLACK)
    except ValueError:
        return generate_input()  # Retry if no space is found

    return grid
